bok.text: Mochi, a kami, speaks with Michiko at Minamo, where she learns that what her father took was a daughter of O-Kagachi, while Toshi learns that the soratami plan to conquer Kamigawa and Hidetsugu attacks Minamo.
Toshi then freezes Mochi and drops the Taken One at his feet, hoping Konda, O-Kagachi and Hidetsugu will fight over it, and teleports Michiko's party back to Jukai.
